name: Muse spaces
desc: Custom experiences you design inside the Muse app
desc_zh: 在 Muse 应用里自行设计的专属体验空间
solves: One generic assistant rarely fits every part of life; a space tailors Muse to a single job or interest.
solves_zh: 一个通用助手很难兼顾生活的方方面面，space 让 Muse 专注一件事。
best_for: You want a Muse that only knows your side project and ignores work email.
best_for_zh: 想要一个只了解副业项目、不碰工作邮件的 Muse。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://about.fb.com/news/ (About Meta newsroom)）。 In-product surface of Muse (in the ledger at 2026-09-08). Official wording is lowercase 'spaces'.
